arProductViewer.help.subtitle:
For the best results:

<olist><litem>The room should be sufficiently lit. You can adjust the light level in the AR tool with the icon on the right-hand side.
</litem><litem>Point the camera to a location in the room where the wall, ceiling, or floor is visible. We recommend including a variety of objects in the view, such as a plant or artwork.
</litem><litem>Rotate the lamp in the AR tool by tapping and dragging where the arrows appear.</litem></olist>
